summary.intent: Implement all outstanding bug fixes and DX/UX work for the callisto release tooling, with a trail created for each outcome and work done on separate branches.
summary.outcome: Created five trails and finished the first one (trail #176, four release-command bugs) on branch fix/release-preview-preconditions, each with a failing-before test and a changeset. The remaining four trails (error envelope, spec-coverage tests, package/fixed-group config, release PR hold comment) were not started in this transcript; final results of the wider test, fmt and clippy runs were not shown.

repo: Release behavior is specified in docs/specs/*.json with criterion IDs (REL-CMD-04, REL-AUTH-05, etc.); fixes aim to make code match specs without changing them.
Changesets live in .changeset/*.md and one is added per fix.

CLI e2e tests for release live in crates/callisto-cli/tests/ (e.g. release_artifact_owner_tests.rs) and use helpers like plugin_artifact_fixture, git and callisto; the harness emits JSON output, not text.

Repository trust checks (shallow clone E266, non-SHA-1 E265) were embedded in observe_git_commit_trust in crates/callisto-model/src/vcs/access.rs and had to be factored out so other routes can run them first.
Quiet subprocess probes should use the quiet runner rather than run_with_timeout, which echoes child stderr.
Tests run with cargo test --offline, and clippy is run with -D warnings across callisto-cli, callisto-graph and callisto-model.

code.finding: prepare_remote demanded a GitHub remote even in preview mode, causing E170 on `release --dry-run` without origin; fixed so preview leaves upload/forge ops unbound.
A clap `requires` on --artifact-repository made it a usage error (exit 2) without --orchestration-revision; removed so the handler returns E231 or ignores the flag.
The origin tag probe used run_with_timeout, which echoes git's fatal stderr for an unreachable origin; switched to the quiet runner.

workflow: Create trails with `entire trail create --no-branch` first to record intent, then branch per trail from origin/main.
Write the test, confirm it fails before the fix and passes after, then add a changeset.
Run package-scoped tests first, then wider release test suites, fmt check and clippy.

friction: Heredocs were refused in the worktree, so appending to test files had to be done with the Edit tool.
The first e2e test assertion expected text output but the harness prints JSON, requiring a rewrite.
Switching branches back to origin/main caused spurious 'changed on disk' notes on files read earlier.
Locating where the trust check and git access lived took many grep passes across crates.
open_items: Trail 2: define and emit a consistent JSON error envelope (command, dryRun, schemaVersion) for release plan/execute/artifact-manifest and release-pr subcommands, and extend REL-CMD-12 and REL-PR-07.
Trail 3: add tests for seven named spec gaps (MX-OUT-02, MX-ERR-06, MX-ERR-07, MX-DISC-02, WS-ID-08, WS-ID-09, VER-CS-03) plus weakly asserted criteria opportunistically.
Trail 4: add ignore support for a private workspace root package and a shared tag/release title for fixed groups (E194), with spec, code, tests and docs/config.md and docs/releasing.md updates.
Trail 5: have the Hold release PR workflow comment explaining why the PR is held, and verify gh pr ready/--undo against real GitHub on the first release.
Confirm the final test, fmt and clippy results for the first branch, then commit, push and open a PR.
